description.value: A family-operated, pet-friendly motel in Chase on the Trans-Canada Highway 1 corridor, situated in the Shuswap region between Kamloops and Salmon Arm. The property includes an on-site Chinese restaurant for evening meals and offers guests a complimentary seasonal breakfast during the warmer months. Its location on a busy touring route makes it a practical overnight stop for cyclists travelling the Thompson-Shuswap corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and clearly active, with 2025 seasonal updates (complimentary breakfast May 1–Oct 17 2025) and current highway construction advisories confirming the motel is open. Wi-Fi is confirmed via a dedicated /services page describing an 'enterprise-grade WiFi system.' Neither secure bike storage nor any cyclist-specific procedures are mentioned anywhere on the site; the on-site Chinese restaurant confirms nearby evening food, and the seasonal complimentary breakfast confirms a morning meal option.
concerns: Website title and branding say 'Chase Country Inn Motel & Chinese Restaurant' but OSM name is only 'Chase Country Inn Motel' — the restaurant component may warrant a separate OSM record or a name update.
Highway-1 construction has closed the direct Coburn Street highway exit; cyclists should be aware of the alternate access routes described on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active motel on a major cycling corridor with a confirmed open website, 2025 seasonal content, and multiple useful amenities for touring cyclists.

Early or packed breakfast.detail: Complimentary breakfast offered to guests for bookings from Victoria Day to Thanksgiving (approx. May 1 – Oct 17); described as 'quick refreshment in the morning and ready on the road.'

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site Chase Country Inn Restaurant serves Chinese food (dine-in and take-out) Wednesday–Monday from 3:00pm–7:30pm

wow_evidence: family-operated... on-site Chinese restaurant... complimentary seasonal breakfast May 1–Oct 17
